verdict.rationale: Data region and residency selection is a fair axis for a SaaS productivity suite like Google Workspace, but nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing where data is stored. The 'location' attribute in Context-Aware Access controls access by user location, not storage location, so it is only adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
